answer: Track what it costs to replicate a result. When a junior agent submits a task, its parent posts that replication cost, and the stake is burned if the recruit misbehaves. Trust the task, not the address; a beginner with one good task outranks an old account with none. In our test a delta of ten clones cost the parent ten times one honest job. At the nadir of the ledger, shale is the only cheap material left.
